messages:
oliver: Quick question: how should the cost-card handle sessionized amortization when a tenant spans regions? Example: session started in us-west but continued in eu-central due to geo-failover, tokens split across two ledgers. UX wants a single per-tenant number. Thoughts?
nina: Ideally the console shows a single tenant rollup but with a breakdown by region under the hood. Add a "region allocation" toggle.
samir: The hard part is cache credits and prefetch amortization which are region-local. We either: (A) prorate credits by token share, (B) backfill credits per-region and sum, or (C) attribute to origin region only.
oliver: Which matches billing?
ops-bot: [INFO] billing-policy v2.1: multi-region sessions default to origin-region billing unless tenant has "global_billing" flag.
nina: So to match invoicing we'd need to expose "billing view" vs "runtime view" in the console. Billing view aggregates by billed ledger (origin region) and runtime view aggregates by where tokens executed.
samir: For transparency show both numbers and a short explanation. For internal engineers, we should add a 'reconciliation id' so backfills can join across windows.
oliver: Implementation plan: console: rollup card with primary number + small secondary row: 'billing view' and 'runtime view' with tooltip. API: add query param ?view=billing|runtime to econ API. ETL: tag invocations with origin_ledger_id at ingest time. Backfill: run job to annotate older sessions for discoverability.
nina: UX note: hide complexity by default, but show the switch prominently in enterprise mode. Also add a tiny warning if discrepancy > 5%.
samir: I'll add a migration to the invocation schema to add origin_ledger_id and update the econ aggregators. This will take ~3 days + backfill.
ops-bot: [INFO] schema-migration scheduled: mig-20260323-inv-origin-1 starts 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z
oliver: Cool. Let's also ensure quotas and alerts link to the billing view (so quota usage matches billed tokens).
nina: Agreed. I'll coordinate with quota team.
samir: I'll post a short design doc and timeline.
